english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for backing or supporting a person, cause, or decision.

exampleSentences.english: I back your decision this time.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 caang1 nei5 gam1 ci3 ge3 kyut3 ding6

english.note: Use this colloquial choice when you support someone or a cause and speak in their favour.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll defend you, so don’t worry.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ding6 caang1 nei5 m4 sai2 geng1
